items.title: Super clean sources
items.text: Sources that are really another title (a spin-off, a sequel, a film of another year), another episode or a cinema recording are left out before you see them. The last row of the list says how many, and shows them if you ask.

items.title: The wrong video never comes back
items.text: When a source plays something else than what you opened, the player notices by itself and moves to the next one. You can also say so from the sources list: that source stays out for good.

items.title: Names stay in the subtitles
items.text: A name written between brackets or quotes is no longer lost with the marks around it. Lines that advertise a site or credit the translators are hidden.

items.title: Old Arabic subtitles read right
items.text: Subtitle files and built-in tracks saved in the old Arabic encoding now show as Arabic, not as symbols.
